merchant/30091.htm.text: Accessory Merchant Ellie: Hello! Our shop specializes in various kinds of jewelry. We have everything from a mysterious ring that can protect you from evil magic to a healing necklace capable of raising the dead! Just tell me what you're looking for.

links.text: View information about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30091-pk.htm.text: Trader Ellie: I'd be happy to trade with you if I could, but it's against the law. I'm sorry. I hear there's a shop somewhere in the wilderness that will deal with someone like you ...

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-01.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: Come in! What can I do for you? Ah, Leikar's order isn't ready yet. I'm sorry. I ordered the ore that I need to make the jewelry from Wharf Manager Felton, but he hasn't delivered it yet. Are you in a hurry? I hate to ask you this, but would you mind going to see Mr. Felton and check…

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-02.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: Come in! What can I do for you? Ah, Leikar's order isn't ready yet. I'm sorry. I placed an order for the ore that I need to make the jewelry through Wharf Manager Felton, but he hasn't delivered it yet. Try back later! (Only a character of level 60 or above can undertake this quest.)

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-04.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: Why are you still here? Go ask Wharf Manager Felton when the ore will arrive. You can find him at Giran Harbor .

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-06.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: Hi there! Have you met Mr. Felton? Since I see you holding the ore, you must have met with him. I think I ordered about 10 of them. If you can give them to me, I will make the jewelry for you. Please put the ore you have up here.

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-05.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: What happened to the ore I requested? Have you met with Mr. Felton? Please pay a visit to Wharf Manager Felton and ask him about the ore.

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-09.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: Ah! I didn't think that you could get it so quickly! Thank you! 5 Oriharukons, 500 units of silver and 150 Thons. I'll make some beautiful jewelry for a special occasion!

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-10.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: These materials won't be easy to find! With some help, you can probably get them quicker. I need 5 Oriharukons, 500 units of silver and 150 Thons. Don't forget!

Q00419_GetAPet/30091-01.html.text: Jeweler Ellie: How did you know that I am a member of the animal lover's association? Ah, I see - Mr. Martin spoke of me. So, what can I do for you?

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-03.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: Please go to Giran Harbor and look for Wharf Manager Felton . Ask him when the ore I ordered will arrive.

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-07.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: Ah, very nice! One, two, three... 10 ore pieces! This should be enough. Now I'll get started! With this Oriharukon and silver, I'll make a very pretty... Oh no! I'm sorry,we've got a problem! I was going to augment the ore so I could make a beautiful piece of jewelry, but I ran out o…

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-08.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: Where are the 10 ore pieces? I can't make jewelry without ore.

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-11.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: Wait here, I won't be long... ... ... Here is the jewelry that Maid Leikar ordered. It's such a large order, I put it into this Gem Box for protection. Please, deliver it safely to Leikar!

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30091-12.ht.text: Jeweler Ellie: Where are the materials I requested? I can't make the jewelry for you unless you give me the materials! Stop fooling around!

Q00419_GetAPet/30091-02.html.text: Jeweler Ellie: We should talk about the wolf that you will be raising... I must first explain their reproductive cycle. A wolf's fertility period is normally 1-2 months , and the pregnancy lasts for approximately 60-62 days . Normally, they will give birth to 3-6 cubs, but can produce up to 10 cubs…
